label: ICMJE: data-sharing statement required for trials
detail: Manuscripts submitted from 1 July 2018 reporting clinical trials must carry a data-sharing statement (ICMJE, 2017 editorial).

label: Plan S in force
detail: cOAlition S funders require immediate open access for grants from 1 January 2021.

label: OSTP memo: no embargo for US-funded research
detail: US Office of Science and Technology Policy memorandum of 25 August 2022; agencies to implement by end of 2025.

label: NIH Data Management and Sharing Policy
detail: In force for NIH applications from 25 January 2023; an approved plan is a term of award.
